newsitem.title: GREECE: FORECAST: Greek Nov inflation seen at 7.9 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST: Greek Nov inflation seen at 7.9 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Greece's consumer price inflation will fall to 7.9 percent year-on-year in November from 8.3 percent in October, according to an informal poll conducted by Reuters.
Fifteen bankers and economists participated in the poll which produced a mean forecast of 7.9 percent. Forecasts ranged from 7.8 percent to 8.0 percent.
A government source told Reuters on Tuesday that inflation would drop below 8.0 percent in November and could even fall below 7.9 percent.
The November inflation figure will likely be released on Friday, an official at the National Statistics Service (NSS) told Reuters. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
